hints.title: Degree Sequence Realizability
hints.text: Determine whether a set of non-negative integers forms the degree sequence of a simple graph.

hints.title: Recursive Degree Elimination
hints.text: Sort degrees descending, extract the highest degree d, and decrement the next d largest degrees.

hints.title: Non-negative Invariant
hints.text: If any degree drops below zero or d exceeds the available elements, no valid simple graph exists.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Havel-Hakimi algorithm repeated sort and decrement reduction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustively testing all adjacency matrix configurations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filters positive degrees into a dynamic list of size N.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply Havel-Hakimi theorem to verify graphical degree sequence.
